body:
Hi Derek,

I read your Smyrna house painting page end to end, and the About Smyrna Georgia passage appears twice on it, back to back, word for word. One heading still says What Our Happy Clients SVG Image Say, which looks like template text that leaked through, and the same page lists two different phone numbers.

None of that reflects the quality of your painting, but a homeowner comparing quotes will read it as carelessness, and painters get judged on attention to detail more than most trades.

So I redesigned your homepage, and the finished design is attached to this email as a PDF. One phone number, one clean page, your interior, exterior, commercial and cabinet painting laid out properly, and Derek front and center the way he should be.

I build websites for home service companies and I would happily clean this up: one tight page per service, consistent contact details, testimonials presented properly. Painting work I have done includes Elkhorn Painting (elkhornpainting.com), a clean site built around photo galleries and easy quote requests, and DreamMaker of Stuart (dreammaker-stuart.com), a home improvement site with the same quote driven layout.

If the design looks right, I can rebuild the rest of the site to match and fix the duplicated pages while I am at it. If not, keep the PDF as free ideas, no hard feelings.

Best,
Hassan
name: Dependable Painting & Remodeling
subject: 🎨 Derek, the Smyrna passage is pasted twice on one page
